nom: Charlotte Tilbury Magic Cream Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: This used to be my favorite moisturizer, and it was the only skincare item I spent this much money on. The product arrived and after I began using it, I noticed my skin was....not bouncing back like it usually does. I would wake up with dry skin. Then I noticed the label on the bottom has changed from "instant turnaround moisturizer" to now say "immediate skin revival". This prompted me to search if it had changed. I no longer have the original outer packaging, so I cannot return it. It simply isn't working for me, and it cost a lot for somebody like me. I am disappointed this change was not made clear.

avis.titre: My skin doesn't feel like sandpaper anymore
avis.texte: I've tried everything including the Tatcha line and my skin prefers this one. I hate when the expensive creams work I will be buying the refills for this one.
I do like this cream. I haven't been using it long enough to see any changes in my skin but it does feel really good. Not greasy or too heavy. I don't wear it under makeup just at night.

avis.titre: Liked it but I feel like their are other good dupes
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First off I like the cream it's good but I think it feels like every other face cream . I like that the scent isn't overpowering or overwhelming but pleasant. The way it absorbs is good and it doesn't stay sticky or have a white base texture . The texture is good it isn't too thin but thick without it being cakey . The application is easy but I just feel it's a little pricey when other face cream seems similar and it's more affordable . Don't think I don't like the face cream I like it and will say I prefer it then other face creams I tried but I think their is a more affordable face cream that works the same .
I purchased this cream for years but now that it's been reformulated in 2026 it stings my eyes. I won't be purchasing again.

I have been using this cream for a few years now and I swear by it. It is literally a "magic cream"... I use this in the morning and at night after my shower, and I can't live without it now. HIGHLY recommend.
The scent was not subtle or pleasant. The cream itself was too thick for me. I've wanted to try this cream for a long time but it just didn't live up to the hype.

avis.titre: This was a no for me.
avis.texte: The fragrance was not subtle or pleasant. The cream itself was too thick my liking. I have wanted to try wanted to try it for so long but it didn't live up to the hype.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] An easy anti- aging m oisturizer, it had all the basics but more geared to night use because of its richness due to my oily/combination skin. An absolute must in cold weather, it leaves your skin plumpy and hydrated.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My skin is sensitive to face creams and I have not broke out from this. It makes my face feel so smooth and hydrated. The container may be small but there is a lot of power in that little jar.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using the Charlotte Tilbury magic cream and aging moisturizer with hyaluronic acid, and it has quickly become one of my faite luxury skin get products. The rich creamy formula provides intense hydration and leaves my skin, feeling soft, smooth and plump throughout the day. I love the radiant, healthy glow it gives my complexion making my skin look refreshed, even without makeup. It also works beautifully as a makeup base helping foundation apply even more evenly and smoothly violet won't replace targeted anti-aging treatments the combination of hyaluronic acid peptides, and can help my skin looking hydrated and youthful. The only downside is the premium price but overall it is the beautiful moisturizer that delivers hydration glow in luxury. I love this product. I would definitely de purchase.

I finally tried this cream and I can see why people like it. It gives a very luxurious feel. Plus, the travel size is just perfect to toss into my purse. It feels really rich and moisturizing and sinks in really nicely on my skin. My skin instantly looks more fresh and glowy right after putting it on. I have been using it mostly at night and it truly works magically overnight; my fine lines have reduced significantly. Overall, it makes my skin look younger, healthier and smoother.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The scent is okay nothing extreme. Packaging is beautiful. Overall its great for dry skin or a night cream but a little overpowering for me as a daily moisturizer in the morning.

I love this brand, but this was not for me. I used it for one week, religiously. It didn't "prime" my skin very well for foundation and after a few days, my skin felt like it was burning/tingling, especially on my neck and cheeks. I stopped using it because the sensation just drove me nuts. It's quite heavy in consistency and I didn't care for the scent, either. I do have oily skin, so this could have been a major factor as to why it didn't work for me.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: This product burned my face and made it patchy red - only used once and will never do it again not sure what in this product could have caused a rash.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For being so expensive, and Charlotte Tilbury, I definitely expected more. It's a good facial moisturizer, but it doesn't feel like anything special. After applying, I feel my skin needs something heavier as my skin will feel a little tight.

I have only been using the Magic cream for a little less than 2 weeks now, bought a small jar to try, but I have noticed improvement in the skin around the eyes, much firmer. My acne scars on my cheeks are also improving and fading. If the magic cream is this good in just 2 weeks, I can't wait to see what it does with continued use

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love love love this product!! It is rich, creamy and very moisturizing! I use this both morning and at night and it doesn't make my face feel greasy at all! It soaks right into the skin. The fragrance is also not bad at all! And it doesn't seem to irritate my sensitive skin.

It's really hydrating without feeling heavy, absorbs quickly into the skin, and has this silky texture that makes it super easy and pleasant to apply. My skin feels soft, smooth, and looks a bit more plump and fresh after using it. It also layers well under makeup, which is a big plus. The only downside is the price, but overall it does what it promises and feels like a nice everyday luxury.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was sent this product in exchange for my honest review, I used the product several times, and to be honest, I was kind of disappointed with this product. It felt really nice and smooth going on, and gave my skin a powdery kind of feeling. I liked that, but then a couple days later my skin would start breaking out really bad. My skin tends to be sensitive sometimes, so I asked my fiance to try the product as well, and she does not have sensitive skin, and she also had that experience. Her skin broke out after using with several small white heads, and she isn't very acne prone. Overall this product would probably be okay if you were older, and beyond the phase where you get acne whatsoever, but for me, and my fiance as well, this just wasn't a hit.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used it a few times and every time my skin does look great. However, I can't tell if it's the product or my great skin routine. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I always love Charlotte Tilbury products and this one is no exception. I have normal/combination skin type and this magic cream works great for me. Just using a little gets the job done and gives you immediate hydration. avis.titre: Helped flaky skin, but strongly scented
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm someone with dry leaning and eczema prone skin, so I often get flaking dry patches all over my face. I love thicker creams like this one. Unfortunately a scent can make or break a product for me, especially when it's as strongly scented as this cream. It was so strong it made my eyes water during application. I have to apply creams to my nose area because it is a place that gets flaky skin the most. Strongly scented creams are a little harder for me to handle as a result. As for the texture of the cream, it is on the thicker side. But I noticed that it absorbs into your skin fairly quickly, with no greasy feeling left behind. I was really impressed! This definitely helped get rid of the tight sensation that my dry skin can sometimes have when it's dehydrated. But the scent was too big of a turn off for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Magic in a bottle. I love this and I know it's pricey but totally worth it. I have combo sensitive skin and this did so well. It leaves my skin hydrated and glowy. Also helps with redness. I use this daily as a moisturizer and primer for makeup. I pair it with the Kylie tint and my skin looks the best it has ever been. Doesn't smell bad and it didn't cause any breakouts. My skin feels soft all day. If you put it on at night the next morning you wake up with glowy, healthy hydrated skin. This is literally the best so worth splurging yourself.

All right, it's overall it's a good value, if you're looking for maintenance for a long time it's a good moisturizer.

avis.titre: Skin cream that fits it's name!!
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. It was incredible to be able to try the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Cream Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid complimentary in exchange for my honest review! This cream fits its name indeed!!! It is like Magic in the way it instantly seems to plump my fine lines and wrinkles on my face! It is a thick, luxurious cream with a satin texture that applies seamlessly onto my skin. It softened and hydrated the texture and look of my dry skin and I feel it would work very well on all skin types, especially normal to very dry skin. It does take a few minutes to absorb into the skin if the weather is warmer, but the results are worth it! I have never had such wonderful improvements to my skin before using the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Cream Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid! The package is mostly comprised of glass that is beautiful and better than plastic. It has a scent of light, white florals which is appealing and does not irritate my skin, nor does it give me a headache. I am over-the-moon happy with this cream and will continue using it and repurchasing it in the future.

I feel like this is an overpriced version of a drugstore brand.
